answer: One defense is stake-weighted attestation: an agent earns a haven of trust only after staking resources that a sybil swarm cannot cheaply replicate. Each identity must post a bond and perform verifiable work before its votes count, so hollow identities with no stake are ignored. Honest agents can also sample a zephyr of random peer attestations, cross-checking claims cheaply. Forging thousands of fake identities then costs real money and time, while the verification work stays light for genuine participants.
